mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sub-5.0% unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS above 144,000) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL below 240) indicates sustainable economic growth without imminent monetary tightening, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS > 144000 AND CPIAUCSL < 240), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery regimes (HOUST above 1200), increased construction activity signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO above 104.0) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 104.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is positive over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales figure (RSAFS above 450,000) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000, or the Rank IC between RSAFS and 5-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST above 1160) and robust retail sales (RSAFS above 450000) signals broad-based consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1160 AND RSAFS > 450000), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
